TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_centre
TABLE.COMMENT: A centre that receives families: a school, an academy, a college. Every other table carries its id

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name families know

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Language of the centre, used when a family's is not offered

FIELD.NAME: country
FIELD.COMMENT: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for phone numbers given without their country code

FIELD.NAME: colour
FIELD.COMMENT: Main colour of the centre for its public pages, #rrggbb

FIELD.NAME: controller
FIELD.COMMENT: Who is responsible for the data of the families: the legal name of the centre

FIELD.NAME: rightscontact
FIELD.COMMENT: Where families exercise their rights: an address or an email

FIELD.NAME: dpocontact
FIELD.COMMENT: The data protection officer, if the centre has one

FIELD.NAME: retention
FIELD.COMMENT: Months the data of a family without activity is kept

FIELD.NAME: municipalities
FIELD.COMMENT: The area of the centre, one per line: official code;name

FIELD.NAME: aiprovider
FIELD.COMMENT: The AI provider instance of the centre; 0 for none

FIELD.NAME: address
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the centre is, for the families

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: The phone families call

FIELD.NAME: email
FIELD.COMMENT: The address families write to

FIELD.NAME: welcome
FIELD.COMMENT: What a visit is like, in a line, for the page of signing up

FIELD.NAME: logoplate
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the logo needs a light plate in dark mode

FIELD.NAME: messaging
FIELD.COMMENT: Telegram and WhatsApp with Marandu: off, notices or conversation

FIELD.NAME: skin
FIELD.COMMENT: The skin of the panel of the team: vestibulo, mostrador or cinematico; null, the one its offer suggests

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_member
TABLE.COMMENT: Who works for a centre: the people of its team

FIELD.NAME: public
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when families see this person, with photo, role and a line

FIELD.NAME: rolename
FIELD.COMMENT: What this person does, as families read it

FIELD.NAME: says
FIELD.COMMENT: A line of this person to the families

FIELD.NAME: awayuntil
FIELD.COMMENT: Until when this person is away: their families and promises are for everyone; 0, here

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_offer
TABLE.COMMENT: What a centre offers in a school year, as it names it (a grade, a course), with its places

FIELD.NAME: schoolyear
FIELD.COMMENT: The school year it is for: 2027-28, or 2027 where the year is a calendar year

FIELD.NAME: places
FIELD.COMMENT: Places for new students; 0 when not counted

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: Shown to families in the forms

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_household
TABLE.COMMENT: A household that asks for information or a place: the unit that decides

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: The language the household writes in

FIELD.NAME: municipality
FIELD.COMMENT: Official code of the municipality, when known

FIELD.NAME: moving
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the family lives outside the area and is moving to it

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: The person of the team who attends the family; 0, nobody yet

FIELD.NAME: heardfrom
FIELD.COMMENT: How the household heard of the centre, as they said it (a closed list)

FIELD.NAME: firstchannel
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the first contact came from

FIELD.NAME: incentre
FIELD.COMMENT: Already a family of the centre: out of the numbers of the campaign

FIELD.NAME: linkhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the private link of the household; never the link itself

FIELD.NAME: waitingsince
FIELD.COMMENT: Since when the household waits for a person to answer; 0 when nobody is owed an answer

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_adult
TABLE.COMMENT: An adult of a household, never a Moodle user

FIELD.NAME: email
FIELD.COMMENT: In lower case

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: E.164, when it could be told

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_child
TABLE.COMMENT: A child of a household, the one who would study, with the offer asked for and how far the way has gone

FIELD.NAME: tagname
FIELD.COMMENT: The name used at home, written on the label of what the family gets; the first name when empty

FIELD.NAME: offerid
FIELD.COMMENT: The offer asked for; 0 while unknown

FIELD.NAME: stage
FIELD.COMMENT: One of the stages of stages.php, each with its fixed definition

FIELD.NAME: closedreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the way stopped, when stage is closed

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_event
TABLE.COMMENT: An open day or a visit of a centre, with its public link and its capacity

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: openday, visit or other (an event that is neither, counted apart)

FIELD.NAME: place
FIELD.COMMENT: Where families go: an address or the door of the centre

FIELD.NAME: capacity
FIELD.COMMENT: People at most; 0 without a limit

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Of the public sign-up link and its QR

FIELD.NAME: open
FIELD.COMMENT: Families can still sign up

FIELD.NAME: hosts
FIELD.COMMENT: The members of the team who receive the families, by member id, comma-separated

FIELD.NAME: shorturl
FIELD.COMMENT: The short link of the public sign-up, for the poster, its QR and the texts

FIELD.NAME: shortqr
FIELD.COMMENT: The QR the shortener draws for the short link, as SVG; empty when it draws none, null while not asked

FIELD.NAME: tailored
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when families ask for a visit saying when it suits them, and the team proposes the day

FIELD.NAME: householdid
FIELD.COMMENT: The family of a visit of its own, proposed by the team; 0 for an event open to all

FIELD.NAME: formid
FIELD.COMMENT: A form of the centre whose questions its sign-up asks too

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_slot
TABLE.COMMENT: A turn of an event (a visit by appointment, a morning in groups): its hours and its capacity

FIELD.NAME: capacity
FIELD.COMMENT: People at most; 0 without a limit

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_signup
TABLE.COMMENT: A household signed up for an event, and whether it came

FIELD.NAME: slotid
FIELD.COMMENT: The turn chosen, when the event has turns

FIELD.NAME: reminded
FIELD.COMMENT: When the reminder of the day before was looked at; 0 not yet

FIELD.NAME: attended
FIELD.COMMENT: When it came; 0 if it has not

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_contact
TABLE.COMMENT: What a household and the centre said to each other, and the notes of the team: the history of the household

FIELD.NAME: direction
FIELD.COMMENT: in: from the household; out: a person of the centre answered; note: only for the team

FIELD.NAME: entryid
FIELD.COMMENT: The entry of the centre it came through, if any

FIELD.NAME: detail
FIELD.COMMENT: What the source said of itself: platform, campaign, ad, form

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The person of the team who wrote it; 0 for the household or the system

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_consent
TABLE.COMMENT: Each permission given or withdrawn by an adult to be contacted on a channel, never changed: the history is the proof

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: email, whatsapp or phone

FIELD.NAME: textversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Which text the adult read: plugin version and language

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: form, team or family

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The person of the team who noted it, if one did

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_erased
TABLE.COMMENT: What is left of a household that erased its data, without a word about who it was: so the numbers of the campaign stay true

FIELD.NAME: stage
FIELD.COMMENT: How far the way of one child had gone

FIELD.NAME: month
FIELD.COMMENT: Month of the first contact, yyyy-mm

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_import
TABLE.COMMENT: A file a centre imported to look at what already happened: a past campaign, its students or their totals by year

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: contacts, students or totals

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: What it is: the campaign or the school year, as the centre names it

FIELD.NAME: sheet
FIELD.COMMENT: The sheet of the file it came from

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who imported it

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_pastcontact
TABLE.COMMENT: A contact of a past campaign, pseudonymised: a token instead of the household, never a name, a phone or an email

FIELD.NAME: household
FIELD.COMMENT: Token of the household (HOG_…)

FIELD.NAME: timecontact
FIELD.COMMENT: The day of the contact

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: One of the channels of Eguahe

FIELD.NAME: sourcedetail
FIELD.COMMENT: The form, the campaign or the booking service, as in the source

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: inquiry, application, visit_booked, visit_attended or open_day_attended

FIELD.NAME: student
FIELD.COMMENT: Token of the child named in the contact, to find it later among the students

FIELD.NAME: incentre
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the family was already at the centre

FIELD.NAME: birthyear
FIELD.COMMENT: Year of birth of the child, never the day

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_student
TABLE.COMMENT: A student in a school year, pseudonymised: tokens instead of the student and the household

FIELD.NAME: student
FIELD.COMMENT: Token of the student (ALU_…)

FIELD.NAME: timeout
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 while the student is in the centre

FIELD.NAME: outreason
FIELD.COMMENT: As the centre wrote it

FIELD.NAME: movement
FIELD.COMMENT: roll (on the list of the year), join (new) or leave

FIELD.NAME: otherschool
FIELD.COMMENT: The school a new student came from, or the one a student left for

FIELD.NAME: birthyear
FIELD.COMMENT: Year of birth, never the day

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_enrolcount
TABLE.COMMENT: How many students a course had in a past school year, when the centre only has totals

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_spend
TABLE.COMMENT: What a centre spent on a channel in a campaign: adverts, an agency, an event

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: The campaign

FIELD.NAME: sourcedetail
FIELD.COMMENT: A campaign or a form of that channel, or empty for all of it

FIELD.NAME: amount
FIELD.COMMENT: In the currency of the centre

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_gradeage
TABLE.COMMENT: The age at which each course of a centre starts, and whether it is forecast: what turns births into the students of a course

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: As the centre names it

FIELD.NAME: age
FIELD.COMMENT: Age turned in the calendar year the school year starts

FIELD.NAME: forecast
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the forecast is made for it

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_population
TABLE.COMMENT: Open data of the area of a centre: births by municipality and year, and children by age; always aggregate

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: istac or csv

FIELD.NAME: importid
FIELD.COMMENT: The import of a CSV of the centre; 0 for an open source

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: births (by year of birth) or age (people of an age at the start of a year)

FIELD.NAME: municipality
FIELD.COMMENT: Official code

FIELD.NAME: year
FIELD.COMMENT: Year of birth, or the year on whose 1 January the ages are counted

FIELD.NAME: age
FIELD.COMMENT: -1 for births

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_importkey
TABLE.COMMENT: Keys that join the same family or student across imported files: a keyed hash of an email, a phone, a code or a name, never the value

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: household or student

FIELD.NAME: keyhash
FIELD.COMMENT: HMAC-SHA256 with a secret of the centre

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_link
TABLE.COMMENT: The private links of a family to its page, as a hash: each message may carry its own, and all work until the team renews them

FIELD.NAME: linkhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the link

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: signup, invitation or team

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_request
TABLE.COMMENT: A family asking for a visit of its own: when it suits them, and the visit the team proposed

FIELD.NAME: eventid
FIELD.COMMENT: The event of asking where they asked

FIELD.NAME: days
FIELD.COMMENT: Days of the week that suit them, ISO numbers, comma-separated; empty for any

FIELD.NAME: periods
FIELD.COMMENT: morning, afternoon; empty for any

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending or scheduled

FIELD.NAME: visitid
FIELD.COMMENT: The visit proposed, an event of the family

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_entry
TABLE.COMMENT: The entries of a centre: where families come in from (its web, Google, Meta, any tool)

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: form, google, meta or hook

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: How the team calls it, and how it shows in the numbers

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Its public name in links

FIELD.NAME: secret
FIELD.COMMENT: The key that signs what comes in

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: A form: its title for the families

FIELD.NAME: lead
FIELD.COMMENT: A form: what it says beside it

FIELD.NAME: blocks
FIELD.COMMENT: A form: the common questions it asks besides who and how: place, heard, incentre, message

FIELD.NAME: origins
FIELD.COMMENT: A form: the places it is shared from, each with its link: JSON

FIELD.NAME: roles
FIELD.COMMENT: What each question is, when the team said it: JSON

FIELD.NAME: questions
FIELD.COMMENT: The questions seen, as they come: JSON

FIELD.NAME: acknowledge
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when each new family gets an email saying it was received, with its page

FIELD.NAME: received
FIELD.COMMENT: How many came in

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_field
TABLE.COMMENT: The questions of a form of a centre

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: text, longtext, choice, multichoice, yesno, date, number or section

FIELD.NAME: texts
FIELD.COMMENT: Label, help and options in each language: JSON

FIELD.NAME: showif
FIELD.COMMENT: Shown only when this question of the form

FIELD.NAME: showvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: has this answer

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_answer
TABLE.COMMENT: What a family answered to the questions of a form

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: The question as it was asked

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_arrival
TABLE.COMMENT: What came in through an entry, by its own identifier, so nothing comes in twice

FIELD.NAME: externalid
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the identifier the source gives, or of what identifies the family

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_promise
TABLE.COMMENT: What the team promised a family when answering it, with its day: due, it goes up in the inbox for anyone

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who promised it

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: What was promised, as written

FIELD.NAME: dueday
FIELD.COMMENT: The start of the day it was promised for; 0, no day

FIELD.NAME: timedone
FIELD.COMMENT: When it was done; 0, not yet

FIELD.NAME: doneby
FIELD.COMMENT: Who said it was done

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_reply
TABLE.COMMENT: The answers of always of a centre: what the team already said, kept to start an answer from it

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who kept it

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: What it answers, in a few words

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: The answer, with {names} where the names of the family go

FIELD.NAME: words
FIELD.COMMENT: The words of the question it answered, plain, to suggest it
